name: Haru
source:
He suddenly appeared in front of Mahora and saved him. Has the power to control a mysterious being in the town called Tosenbou. He is interested in being with the demons and offers to befriend Mahora. Has a pompous attitude and lacks common sense.

[Translated from [url=http://lovedelivery.biz/suito/chara.html]the official website[/url].]
